findings.description: The interface name is hardcoded as 'eth0'.
The code does not validate the IP address or interface name.
strlen(interface) is used, but if the interface name is not null-terminated or too long, it could cause issues.
The return value of inet_pton is not checked.
The socket is not closed before program exit.
